macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit an initial upward vector with a slight posterior-lateral lyrate curvature relative to the skull base.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white transverse patches present on the lower foreleg and hindleg joints; two distinct white spot markers visible on the mandibular/facial region.
